prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a deliberately simple, realistic desktop web app screenshot for a Java backend take-home assessment. This is a small functional demo, not an enterprise operations dashboard. White page, a centered content column about 1050px wide, generous blank space below, dark slate text, fine gray dividers, default shadcn-style small-radius inputs/buttons and typography. Top header "Transaction demo" at left and small muted "Sample data" text at right. Immediately under header ONLY three simple horizontal tabs: "Transactions", "Fraud checks", "Statements". No sidebar, no logos, no avatars, no workspace selector, no dashboard cards, no charts, no drawers, no toast, no footer links, no developer jargon, no extra navigation, no icons unless essential. A restrained dark navy primary button. Flat screenshot, landscape roughly 4:3. Use exactly the short content requested, do not add more fields, buttons, text, or panels. Simple enough to implement in a few React components. Same visual style across all three screenshots. Fictional customer Amina Dlamini. Active tab Transactions. Title "Transactions". One sentence below "Load transactions from three mock sources and view them together." A compact numbered text flow directly below the sentence: "1. Load sample data  →  2. Categorize automatically  →  3. View totals". A single control row with labeled customer select "Customer" showing "Amina Dlamini" at left, and a primary "Load sample data" button at right. Below it quiet inline success text "3 transactions loaded from 3 sources." Below that one simple table with columns Description, Source, Category, Amount. Exactly three rows: "November salary | Bank API | Income | +R25,000.00"; "FreshMart | CSV file | Groceries | −R842.50"; "GadgetHub | Card events | Shopping | −R5,100.00". All three rows have same neutral white background; no selected row and no row buttons. Below table a plain single totals line, NOT cards: "Money in: R25,000.00     Money out: R5,942.50". Keep the remaining bottom of screenshot empty. No fraud badges or separate provenance panel. The visual should communicate a tiny useful application with one core action.

White page, a centered content column about 1050px wide, generous blank space below, dark slate text, fine gray dividers, default shadcn-style small-radius inputs/buttons and typography. Top header "Transaction demo" at left and small muted "Sample data" text at right. Immediately under header ONLY three simple horizontal tabs: "Transactions", "Fraud checks", "Statements". No sidebar, no logos, no avatars, no workspace selector, no dashboard cards, no charts, no drawers, no toast, no footer links, no developer jargon, no extra navigation, no icons unless essential. A restrained dark navy primary button. Flat screenshot, landscape roughly 4:3. Use exactly the short content requested, do not add more fields, buttons, text, or panels. Simple enough to implement in a few React components. Same visual style across all three screenshots. Fictional customer Amina Dlamini. Active tab Fraud checks. Title "Fraud checks". One sentence below "Loaded transactions are checked automatically." A compact numbered text flow directly below: "1. Load transactions  →  2. Apply rules  →  3. View results". A single static customer line "Customer: Amina Dlamini". A simple table with columns Transaction, Amount, Result. Exactly three rows: "November salary | +R25,000.00 | Not flagged"; "FreshMart | −R842.50 | Not flagged"; "GadgetHub | −R5,100.00 | Review needed". Only Review needed is an amber badge; the other results are plain muted text. Directly beneath table one small pale amber explanation box, not a panel or drawer: bold "Why GadgetHub was flagged" and exact sentence "This debit of R5,100.00 exceeds the demo rule threshold of R5,000.00." A small line beneath "A flag indicates possible fraud, not a confirmed finding." No actions, no rule editing, no assignment, no resolution workflow, no timeline, no metrics, no extra controls. Leave substantial blank space below. The single value rule is only applied to DEBIT transactions, salary is a credit and is correctly not flagged.
